predecessors.name: French Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon
predecessors.text: the Sanjak of Alexandretta, 'an autonomous province of Syria' under the French mandate, autonomous under a League statute from November 1937

successors.name: Republic of Turkey
successors.text: 'By 23 July 1939 ... the territory was fully annexed by Turkey', as Hatay Province

ledger.x: 2 September 1938: the assembly proclaims the Hatay State at Antakya.
ledger.cpn: French Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon

ledger.x: 23 July 1939: Hatay is annexed by Turkey.

certainty.note: The old administrative boundary of the sanjak, held since the autonomous regime of 1921 and the League statute of November 1937; neither page describes a survey.
